phase_name: Phase 143E Canonical Report and Metadata Repair
summary: Independently reproduced Phase 143F's report-integrity finding: hand-patch d5b09297 patched only the header block of .pcae/phase-completion-report.md and .pcae/phase-completion-metadata.json for Phase 143E, leaving no_go_confirmation and the Markdown body's Summary/No-Go/Recommended-Next-Phase sections stale from Phase 143D -- confirmed directly via git show d5b09297, not merely cited. Refined the root cause: phase.py reads meta['no_go_confirmation'] verbatim into the rendered report; the field itself was never corrected by d5b09297 (confirmed absent from its diff), and the generator rendered it faithfully -- not a generator defect. Central finding: no live repair to the git-tracked canonical files was required, because Phase 143F's own governed completion (sync 072b6168) already superseded the stale 143E content with correct, internally coherent Phase 143F data before this phase began; the stale window is fully historical and correctly preserved, not rewritten, in hand-patches d5b09297/c894c988. Checked and confirmed accurate: docs/PHASE_143E_...md, PROJECT_STATUS.md, CHANGELOG.md, tasks/DONE.md. Classified the 'Report generated by PCAE Phase 92A' footer as intentional, data-driven generator versioning (canonical_report_used flag), not a defect -- verified against both the archived 143E snapshot (canonical_report_used=true) and current 143F data (canonical_report_used=false). Documented, as a disclosed Observation only (no code change, per this phase's own scope bound against redesigning the generator), that write_canonical_report() is never called from pcae phase complete, requiring a manual per-phase sync enforced only by title-only phase-ID matching. See docs/PHASE_143F.1_PHASE_143E_CANONICAL_REPORT_AND_METADATA_REPAIR.md.
